sloka: देवानां भयभीतानां हरिणा राक्षसर्षभौ ।प्रतिज्ञातो वधो ऽस्माकं चिन्त्यतां यदिह क्षमम् ।। ७.६.३३ ॥
transliteration: devānāṁ bhayabhītānāṁ hariṇā rākṣasarṣabhau ।pratijñāto vadho 'smākaṁ cintyatāṁ yadiha kṣamam ।। 7.6.33 ॥

translations.english: Then Narayana addressed the gods, led by Indra, saying, "I will kill those enemies of the gods; O gods, become free from anxiety."
